consult_when: an image needs subject, art-direction, composition or effect references
motion or scroll behavior not already established
WebGL, 3D, canvas, shader or other high-cost visual mechanism
custom media or asset is necessary to judge the direction
owner needs evidence that a known pattern is mature and adaptable
implementation mechanism is uncertain or technically risky
do_not_consult_when: standard primitive already defined by the design system
exact reuse of an approved project pattern
routine spacing, typography or component state with no new uncertainty
the only reason is to make a section look more premium
the resource cannot change the decision materially
policy.reuse_rule: Presence in this registry never grants reuse rights. Reuse must satisfy the source reuse_class, current license/terms, provenance and project constraints at the moment of use.
